item.title: What Is a Nomogram and Why Would It Interest Me?
item.description:
📝 Since an equation in two variables is usually represented by a graph, most nomograms represent formulas that involve three or more variables. You’ll realize that a nomogram can solve even for implicit variables that cannot be isolated on one side of the equation. Nomograms continue to be used extensively in medical fields.
🔗 Read more: https://lefakkomies.github.io/pynomo-doc/introduction/introduction.html#what-is-a-nomogram-and-why-would-it-interest-me
